summary: Third attempt: a documentation-only review-driven correction of the single remaining MEDIUM finding in docs/implementation/12.2/reviewer-report.attempt-2.json. The finding was that docs/project-status.md line 708 stated the per-selector badge value allowlist bound as 'at most 64 entries per selector, each at most 64 characters', while the shipped bound is at most 32 entries per selector (BadgeDefinition.MaximumAllowedValues = 32 in src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeDefinition.cs:36, enforced by RendererConfiguration.Validate at src/ArrTags/Configuration/RendererConfiguration.cs:160). This attempt changed the entry-count bound from 64 to 32 so the sentence now reads 'at most 32 entries per selector, each at most 64 characters'. A follow-up scan of every surface touched by the attempt-2 reconciliation (docs/project-status.md, docs/implementation-readiness.md, docs/limitations.md, docs/architecture.md) plus a repo-wide check found no other allowlist-bound or suite-count factual error: docs/architecture.md:1195-1196 already states 32 entries / 64 characters, docs/implementation-readiness.md carries no allowlist bound and no current suite count, docs/limitations.md V6 and docs/project-status.md both state the current v1.1 working suite as Failed 0, Passed 1,445, Skipped 63, Total 1,508 with the distinct historical 1.0.1.0 counts (1,228/60/1,288 and 1,244/44/1,288) preserved, and docs/decisions.md:2231 (ADR-017 clause 5), docs/data-model.md:890, PLANS.md:4509/4537, and docs/changelog.md:3329 all consistently state 32. No source or test file was modified in this attempt; the functional implementation and the attempt-1/attempt-2 changes are unchanged. The attempt-2 report is preserved as docs/implementation/12.2/worker-report-attempt-2.json.
